title: The bot's lifecycle lives in four loose variables, and tick() keeps a halted flag beside sent === 'halt'
evidence: app/lib/youtube-bot.server.ts module state: isRunning, tickInFlight, cronIntervalId and firstTickId together encode stopped / armed / ticking, set and cleared in startYouTubeBot, stopYouTubeBot and runTick. One union (stopped; running with its timers; ticking) behind a pure transition() would hold it. tick() also sets `let halted = true` when postClaimed answers 'halt', only to skip processFollowUps: the same fact twice. Found in the C15 review (PR 1372); no behaviour change wanted. The halted half is gone: PR 1386 (d42a7beaa) made the tick's posting one union, Posting (app/lib/youtube-bot-post-result.ts:61-75; youtube-bot.server.ts:290 and :395 break on kind halted); the four module variables remain (youtube-bot.server.ts:97-101)
